workflows.name: planning
workflows.fallback: Use ordinary conversation for the one approval and persist the plan under .mentor. Without a Stop hook the run-until-done loop is a prose rule (keep working until a terminal state); without subagents each step is verified serially in the main thread and labelled self-graded.

workflows.name: ux-review
workflows.fallback: Use the portable skill directly from ordinary conversation; it needs no Mentor helper or .mentor state.

workflows.name: delivery
workflows.fallback: The playbook is a portable skill loaded by planning. Without slash-command facades use the host's shell and approval flow; without subagents the pre-merge grade is self-graded and says so.

workflows.name: visual-artifacts
workflows.fallback: Write the local HTML review page under .mentor (pinned CDN scripts allowed); hosted Artifact publication is optional.

workflows.name: retrospective
workflows.fallback: The retro runs on Claude Code or Codex and reads source transcripts from either host's store (resolving identity from $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID or $CODEX_THREAD_ID, else a unique cwd + opening-prompt match). It is a portable playbook loaded by planning, so it needs no slash-command facade; /mentor:retro is a thin Claude Code entry point. When subagents are unavailable the three lenses run serially in-thread and are labelled self-graded. When session identity or a transcript store cannot be resolved, the result is labelled partial with no fallback to the real stores.
